hook.text: A developer posted daily progress in a public channel. Within a month, three teams asked to collaborate.

buildup.text: Working out loud means sharing work-in-progress publicly: drafts, ideas, blockers, learnings.

discovery.text: It replaces hallway conversations. People who see your work in progress can offer help before you ask.

twist.text: It feels vulnerable to share unfinished work. But perfection shared too late misses the feedback window.

climax.text: Post a brief update in a shared space when you finish a milestone. Progress reports build trust.

punchline.text: Share in progress, not only the final result.

quiz.question: What is the main benefit of working out loud for remote teams?
options: It enables collaboration and help before you even ask
It creates more work for managers to supervise
